definitions.explanation: A cooking method in which food is cooked by steam. Also used as a prefix to describe steamed dishes.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{料理|りょうり}はヘルシーだ。
{茶碗|ちゃわん}{蒸|む}しは{日本|にほん}の{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{蒸|む}し{料理|りょうり}だ。
examples.english: Chawanmushi is a representative Japanese steamed dish.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}は{焼|や}くよりも{蒸|む}しにした{方|ほう}が、{素材|そざい}の{味|あじ}を{活|い}かせると{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think steaming fish rather than grilling it brings out the natural flavor of the ingredients.

notes:
{蒸|む}し refers to the steaming method of cooking. It is derived from the verb {蒸|む}す (to steam). This is distinct from {虫|むし} (insect) and {無視|むし} (ignoring), which share the same reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蒸|む}し{料理|りょうり} (steamed dishes)
- {蒸|む}し{器|き} (steamer)
- {蒸|む}し{鶏|どり} (steamed chicken)
- {蒸|む}し{野菜|やさい} (steamed vegetables)

COMMON STEAMED DISHES:
- {茶碗|ちゃわん}{蒸|む}し (egg custard steamed in a cup)
- {酒|さか}{蒸|む}し (sake-steamed)
- {蒸|む}しパン (steamed bread/bun)

Steaming is one of the fundamental cooking techniques in Japanese cuisine, valued for preserving the natural flavors and nutrients of ingredients.
